title: Knight Rider
description:
S1 E13 — Forget Me Not
Michael must help an amnesia victim (Judy Landers) recover to prevent an assassination; guest Alejandro Rey.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E1 — The Wedworth Townsend Act
An assembly bill to create a paramedic program meets opposition from doctors and firefighters; pilot for the series.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E2 — The Wedworth Townsend Act
An assembly bill to create a paramedic program meets opposition from doctors and firefighters; pilot for the series.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E3 — Mascot
Gage promises to care for an injured woman's dog; the paramedics save five lives including a diabetic and a man trapped on a ledge.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E4 — Botulism
An injured cameraman proves to have more than a broken leg, leading Brackett to search for a botulism source; guest Susan Seaforth.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E5 — Cook's Tour
DeSoto and Gage deliver a baby over the father's protests; DeSoto worries about a dinner he is planning for the station-house crew.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E6 — Brushfire
A canyon fire threatens the residents of a housing development and keeps the paramedics on round-the-clock duty; guest Tony Dow.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E7 — Dealer's Wild
DeSoto and Gage talk down an airplane flown by a teenage boy whose father, the pilot, suffered a heart attack while at the controls.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E8 — Nurses Wild
The paramedics hold a demonstration for student nurses, one of whom interests Gage; the hospital staff saves a robber and his victim.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E9 — Publicity Hound
Gage resents media attention given to a paramedic (Gary Crosby) from another squad; Brackett clashes with a tycoon over a diagnosis.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E10 — Weird Wednesday
The paramedics and hospital staff deal with a stubborn elderly woman (Jeanette Nolan), a parachutist in a tree and other odd cases.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E13 — Breakout!
Hannibal devises an elaborate escape plan after B.A. and Murdock are mistaken for accomplices in a robbery and sentenced to work on a chain gang.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E14 — Cup A'Joe
B.A. and Murdock help a diner owner and his daughter fight a corrupt tycoon who wants their land for an off-ramp.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E15 — The Big Squeeze
The team works from a pub to stop a loan shark (Joseph Sirola) from terrorizing small businesses; guest Wings Hauser.
